text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer... You're always taking care of 
me, but...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(From what I've seen, they seem quite 
tired lately.)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(It's not really a reward per se, but... I 
want to do something for them. 
Something...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Trainer, here is an energy drink.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and drink it. Though... I wonder 
who left it here.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have some leftover supplements. 
And... they're pretty high-quality 
supplements too.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I went out of my way to buy 
it, but... ...Do you want it?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(All she's saying is "thank you." And in a 
total monotone, too.)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, they must be tired. I should 
find a way to let them unwind...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...A bar, huh? Well, we're both adults. 
Letting her unwind in a place like this 
might not be so..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Right, if I invite them myself...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you always have it rough. How 
about it, wanna go grab a quick drink?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, it's just thanks for 
the usual. I know a good place. Leave 
today to me!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no... Who is this stylish little 
professor brimming with confidence?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I could say something like 
that. Showing subtle consideration and 
all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shaka shaka shaka...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Besides... Trainer might be busy. Calling 
out would just be a nuisance...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: "No, but at this rate... No, no, no..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Customer—a stroll through the Underworld, 
is it?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Ha, Gimlet. Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is a second home to me. Everything 
is... for the sake of repayment.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Reimbursement? I don't really get it... Is 
that your part-time job?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
If so, I'm sorry for overstaying my 
welcome. I just had a few troubling things 
on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... I see, did I say that out 
loud?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has done so much for me. 
Especially you, Trainer. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I want to invite them out for a drink, 
but... it would surely be a nuisance. I 
know it. I just know it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh, a tragic prophecy? Such a thing is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It's an illusion. Nothing more than an 
illusion.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: What? An illusion?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. The veil of night is one's own 
weakness. Kindness, ultimately, is nothing 
more than self-indulgence. If that is so—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I just need to push it onto them and 
intoxicate them too. Whether it's a giant 
tree or not, you won't know until you 
tempt it."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't tell me... are you saying I should 
force an invite?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"It is already too late. The throne of the 
deep sea is now held in check. In other 
words—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Pact formed! Return when the evening star 
shines.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Y-You went and booked it on your 
own? Mmmgh~

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Kindness and the like... is mere 
self-indulgence.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Without pushing it onto them... there's no 
way to know.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll just take the plunge... There's 
no turning back now. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Because I already made a reservation!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I need to talk to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shaka shaka shaka...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dr. Leitz invited me out for a drink. It 
was out of the blue, but I was really 
glad.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: You seemed tired lately. So... you know...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate everything you've done for 
me. However...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard. Please... 
don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
If the Trainer collapses, then everything 
will be lost.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she was trying to comfort me. But 
conversely, that means I ended up making 
her worry.
choice_data_list:
I'll be careful not to push myself too 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... Please do. If you push 
yourself too hard, Trainer, well, that is 
to say...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Because you'll get tired, Trainer. It's 
better if you don't. Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, now you see. This land is 
unmistakably the root of the Great Tree.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The vow has been fulfilled. Now, take this 
peerless nectar. Drink deep of the 
blessing that has descended upon you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet also served her original 
drinks. Amidst our busy daily lives, it 
turned out to be a truly wonderful night.
